payload.comment:
Reporting stage is internally consistent and all cross-references verify correctly. No deterministic findings are present, so no stop is warranted. Verification performed: (1) human_review_queue.count (2658) matches abstention_report.human_review_count (2658); (2) comparison_report.agentic_accuracy (0.896379) matches abstention_report.base_test_accuracy (0.896379); (3) comparison_report.baseline_accuracy (0.821309) matches baseline_report.accuracy (0.821309); (4) accuracy_delta 0.896379−0.821309=0.075070 ✓; (5) common_split_fingerprint and common_seed (42) match across baseline and comparison reports; (6) 7180×0.370195≈2658 (abstain count) ✓; (7) risk_coverage_curve at target 0.8 is consistent with top-level selective_risk (0.036931), test_coverage (0.629805), and threshold (0.73602929); (8) OOD evaluation is properly scoped as controlled-corruption-proxy with three severity levels and two scoring functions; ood_pass=true is appropriate for this scope; (9) search_report correctly reports test_metrics_used=false; (10) all artifacts carry schema_version 1.0 and SHA-256 hashes where applicable.

Carried-forward warnings that must be addressed in the final report: (a) ~10 pp validation-to-test accuracy gap (0.9948 vs 0.8964) — the 80 % coverage guarantee is a validation-set guarantee, not a test-set guarantee; (b) test selective risk 0.0369 vs validation risk 0.0010 at 80 % target coverage (~37× inflation) — downstream consumers must not rely on the validation risk figure; (c) OOD test AUROC (0.896–0.952) is 4–9 pp below validation AUROC (0.990–0.998), consistent with the broader distribution shift; (d) model_family fields (resnet18, tiny_cnn) carry transformer-specific config keys (patch_size, num_heads, mlp_ratio, tokenizer_layers, positional_encoding, pooling=cls) — verify inert in the actual code path; (e) early_stopping_patience=3 in final config vs 5 in selected search trial — confirm intentional; (f) rationale references a prior resnet18 baseline of 0.9908 not present in the current search_report — record provenance; (g) best_epoch=15 equals the final epoch with validation accuracy still improving — 15-epoch budget may be insufficient; (h) Class 7 recall 0.622 and Class 5 F1 0.713 are the weakest classes; 246 class-0→class-5 and 63 class-7→class-2 misroutes warrant targeted error analysis; (i) test-set class-imbalance ratio (~3.9×) exceeds the 1.63× cited in rationale — confirm which split the figure refers to.

The anomaly_abstention review returned action=revise (severity=warning), flagging that the abstention report should more explicitly frame the coverage guarantee as validation-set and note the risk inflation. This is a documentation improvement, not a correctness error, and should be incorporated into the final report narrative. The anomaly_reporting review returned action=continue (severity=ok), confirming the reporting stage artifacts are complete and consistent. reporting_status.complete_through_stage=comparison is expected since the reporting stage is the current stage under review. All issues are documentation/framing warnings; no deterministic correctness violations were identified.
